When is GTA 6 Online coming out? 🌐 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
GTA Online arrived two weeks after GTA 5 in 2013. GTA 6 launched as a single-player game and Rockstar hasn't announced an online mode or a date. The '2027' going around came from Twitch's CEO in a Bloomberg interview, not from Rockstar, so treat it as a report. GTA 5's GTA Online keeps getting updates. Checked right before posting.

Sources: VICE, GTABase, HuffPost, Covers.

facts_note: Nov 24: GTA Online launched Oct 1, 2013, two weeks after GTA 5 (Sep 17) (our gta-6-vs-gta-5 guide, Forbes); GTA 6 single-player at launch, no online mode or date announced by Rockstar (VICE, GTABase, HuffPost); '2027' = Twitch CEO Dan Clancy to Bloomberg, a report, not Rockstar (VICE, Covers); Take-Two keeps supporting GTA Online (GTABase, HuffPost). 'NO DATE' can stop being true any day: RE-CHECK within 2 h of the slot; if Rockstar announces anything, rewrite or skip.
